ops.title: Migrate tool denial detection from text sniffs to structured JSON fields
ops.description: Replace `facts.is_denial`'s DENIAL_PREFIX text match with the record-level `toolDenialKind` field ("user-rejected" | "permission-rule"), structured-first with text fallback, computed once at the parsing layer (`ToolResultBlock.denial_kind`). `ToolFact.denied` keeps meaning user rejection only; mining denial detectors ignore permission-rule blocks.

ops.text: ToolResultBlock.denial_kind populated: toolDenialKind when present, else user-rejected iff is_error and DENIAL_PREFIX prefix, else None — in both backends
facts.is_denial and mining denial_results are field reads (no DENIAL_PREFIX at call sites); denied == (denial_kind == "user-rejected")
Mining parity battery green: structured denial mined, permission-rule NOT mined, legacy banner-only still mined
rust/src/generated/* regenerated via scripts/build_rust_literals.py and tests/test_literals_parity.py green
